app.name: acikeczanevarmi.com
app.tagline: See the pharmacies on duty tonight across Northern Cyprus on the map. Find the one nearest you, check its duty hours, and call it or get directions in one tap.
app.title: North Cyprus On-Duty Pharmacies — Open Tonight
app.description: Pharmacies on duty tonight in Northern Cyprus. See every open pharmacy's location, phone number and duty hours on the map.
app.ogTitle: Which pharmacy is on duty tonight in North Cyprus?
app.ogDescription: Find the nearest on-duty pharmacy on the map and call it in one tap. Duty hours and directions included.
app.ogImageAlt: acikeczanevarmi.com — map of on-duty pharmacies in North Cyprus

hours.oncall: Duty <t>{open}–{close}</t> · pharmacist on the phone until <t>{until}</t>

locask.title: Turn on location to sort by distance
locask.body: It works without location too: pick a region below and pharmacies are listed island-wide.

denied.title: Location permission is off
denied.body: Distances can't be shown. Continue by picking a region, or enable the permission in your browser settings.
denied.help: Tap the lock icon in your browser's address bar, allow Location, then reload the page.

error.title: Couldn't load the list
